name: ship-gencore-phoenix
summary: Grey angular hard-surface fighter: a narrow pointed fuselage with a dark cockpit slot and a light canopy plate, flanked by two sharp, pointy blade-like wings joined to it by low struts near the tail.

traits: dark slot across the fuselage behind the nose
glossy dark glass, crisp edges, set in a frame
bright glint at its upper edge (col 11, row 7) is shine, not a bump
angular, about 4 px wide
features.note: The cockpit: a dark band at row 6 and a dark slot at rows 8-9 with a bright glint between. Must read as a distinct dark glass windshield, not painted grey hull.

traits: pointed, tapering from 4 px to a tip at row 1
faceted, crisp ridge down the centre
metal, light ridge at col 11 is sheen
features.note: The narrow pointed nose ahead of the windshield; must taper in width and height to a point, not round off.

traits: sharp, pointy blade-like wing (the user's description)
thin blade: a knife-edge outer side and a crisp ridge on top, not a slab, pod or capsule
pointed tip at the front (row 9) and tapering to a point at the back
flat faces meeting at hard creases
polished metal
bright inner top edge (col 4, rows 10-19) as a crisp ridge
features.note: Left wing: a long, sharp, pointy blade beside the fuselage with an empty gap between them, joined only by the strut. It must read as a blade with knife edges and pointed ends, never a rounded pod.

traits: sharp, pointy blade-like wing (the user's description)

pointed tip at the front (row 9) and tapering to a point at the back
flat faces meeting at hard creases
polished metal
bright inner edge (col 19, rows 17-19)
features.note: Right wing: a long, sharp, pointy blade beside the fuselage with an empty gap between them, joined only by the strut. It must read as a blade with knife edges and pointed ends, never a rounded pod.

traits: light grey plate, about 3x3 px
raised slightly, flat top, chamfered edges
the bright centre pixel is sheen, not a lump
features.note: The light canopy/armour plate just behind the windshield; a flat raised plate, never a dome.

traits: straight horizontal bar 4 px long, 2 px deep
bright top edge (row 20), darker underside
box section, low
features.note: Left strut joining the pod to the fuselage near the tail; must be a visible connecting bar across the gap.

traits: straight horizontal bar 4 px long, 2 px deep
bright top edge, darker underside
box section, low
features.note: Right strut joining the pod to the fuselage.

traits: 1 px wide bright line down the centre (col 11, rows 14-17)
straight, crisp raised ridge on the back
metal
features.note: A raised ridge running down the fuselage top behind the canopy; reads as a crisp straight line.

traits: dark 2x2 px slot (cols 11-12, rows 18-19)
cut into the hull about 1 px
framed by lighter hull on both sides
features.note: Dark vent behind the spine ridge; must be cut in, not painted.

traits: dark engine housing at the back, narrowing to row 25
nozzle slot (cols 11-12, rows 23-24) darker
angular block
features.note: Engine block at the tail of the fuselage, darker than the hull.

traits: straight-sided, about 8 px wide
faceted panels, darker lower-right side is sprite shading
slightly lighter side panels at cols 15 rows 12-14
hard edges, not inflated
features.note: The central body from the cockpit to the struts; a crisp, tall hard-surface hull.
